description: Probe FF-output unions beyond its measured sensitive pair
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,596 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold. There have been 63 prior macro-attempts and 540 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0165/micro-0001 at 1,596/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0165/micro-0002, where a QKV union scored 98.99%. In this tensor, FF-output pair 143/100 most recently scored 98.95% in attempt-0148 after attention recalibration and is excluded. Hypothesis: sensitivity is coordinate-specific in the shared FF-output map too, so the next-nearest unmeasured scalar pair can qualify under the now 44-parameter-smaller attention frontier. The helper orders eligible adjacent groups by absolute difference and adds one union per official micro-trial. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than retesting 143/100 again because that exact pair has failed twice under materially different attention states.
summary: The FF-output skip-path evaluated seven ordered unions. Six qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,596 to 1,590 parameters; micro-0007 proposed 1,589, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 6 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used seven official migrations/verifications over about 8m40s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 20-trial/25-minute cap, showing the earlier nearest-pair failure was coordinate-specific.
